bugs.text: Path time is divided by pathDur twice, so entries take dur^2 (about 11.6s), dives about 6s, beam approaches about 4.8s and challenge fly-throughs about 17.6s. Groups crawl and pile up at the top.
A Boss holding a captured fighter is excluded from dives, so it never dives again and rescue is only possible in the short time left on the capture beam.
Captive-fires-at-player code checks capt.captive, which is always null, so it never runs.

Escort Goei never leave the 'escort' state after their Boss returns. They stay glued beside it outside their own slots, stack up on later dives, score as divers (160), and stop the formation from breathing.
The captured ship is put in the Boss's own slot, overlapping it, and the Goei below is moved into row 0 too, so three sprites overlap.
Dual fighter: shots spawn at x-8 and x+8 while the ships sit at x and x+16. The ramming box is off-centre, and a hit always removes the right ship.
initPlayer runs at every stage start and resets dual to false, so the dual fighter is lost between stages.
Challenge stage: waves 0, 2 and 4 end on screen and vanish in place, and hits score the normal 50/80/150 instead of 100.
Title score table prints '800  1600' on top of the Boss '400' (both at y=150), so the text is garbled. A meaningless '150000 FOR HIGH SCORE' line is also shown.
Goei sprite rows are misaligned (right wing missing in frame 0), so it looks lopsided.

summary: A compact, clean, well-separated implementation: a correct fixed-timestep loop, integer-scaled 224x288 canvas, twinkling multi-coloured starfield, a full HUD with arcade badge denominations, localStorage high score, a results screen and a complete title -> stage -> game over -> results -> title loop. It ran without errors in the play-test. The core shooting loop works: curved group entries, a swaying formation, curved dives that wrap back to their slots, a two-hit Boss that changes colour, escort-based Boss scoring and a nicely animated tractor beam that captures the ship. It is held back by a time-scaling bug that makes every path 2.5-4x slower than intended, and by weak handling of the signature mechanic. A Boss holding a captive never dives again, so rescue is nearly unreachable. The captive never fires and sits on top of the Boss. The dual fighter's shots and hitbox don't line up with its sprites. Escorts stay glued to their Boss for good and stop the breathing. The challenge stage reuses entry curves and its enemies vanish on screen with the wrong per-hit score. It feels like Galaga at a glance, but several signature details are broken or approximate.
